_comment: The edit decision list. Each scene names its narration, its source footage with in/out points measured from the original .mov, and its on-screen text. Scene LENGTH is never set here - every scene is cut to the length of the narration audio Gemini returns, so the picture always fits the voice. Change text, re-run build.sh, and the whole film re-times itself.

scenes.vo: Applying for jobs is mostly retyping. The same details, into a different form, every time.
This is the app that stops that. Here is the whole thing.

card.big2: Then find a job, and apply.

scenes.vo: You fill in your details once. Name, phone, address.
scenes.head: Your details, once

scenes.vo: Add your résumé and a photo. No signature saved? It draws one from your name.
scenes.head: Résumé, photo, signature
scenes.sub: No signature saved? It draws one from your name

scenes.vo: No résumé yet? Rough notes in, a written résumé out.
scenes.head: No résumé yet?
scenes.sub: Rough notes in — a written résumé out

scenes.vo: Then pick the format for where you are applying. A German CV is not a US résumé.
scenes.head: Formatted for the country
scenes.sub: PDF or Word, ready to send

scenes.vo: Now the jobs. You search the live web from inside the app. Real, current listings.
scenes.head: Search the live web
scenes.sub: Real listings, not a stale copy

scenes.vo: One tap pulls the whole posting in, and saves it.
scenes.head: One tap to pull it in
scenes.sub: The full posting, saved to your list

scenes.vo: It reads the role, researches the company, and writes a cover letter for that specific job.
scenes.head: The cover letter writes itself
scenes.sub: For that role — not a template

scenes.vo: Pick your region, download as PDF or Word.
scenes.head: Your region, your format

scenes.vo: Then the part that saves real time. Open the employer's own form, and tap the robot.
scenes.head: Auto Fill the employer's form

scenes.vo: It fills the whole thing in. Details, dropdowns, the questions your résumé answers.
scenes.head: Filled, and attached

scenes.vo: Your files attach themselves. Submit, and it is logged on your dashboard.
scenes.head: Submitted, and tracked

scenes.vo: So that is the whole loop. Find a job, and apply, without typing it all out again.
CVApplyr. Free to start, on iPhone and Android.

card.sub: Free to start — iPhone and Android
